data.question: Write a program that reads a two-digit number and prints twice the number when both of its digits divide it exactly, otherwise prints the number itself.

sections.heading: Question
sections.body: Write a program that reads a two-digit number and prints twice the number when both of its digits divide it exactly, otherwise prints the number itself.

sections.heading: What the supplied code does
sections.body: It checks int(N) % int(N[0]) and int(N) % int(N[1]) and prints int(N) * 2 only when both checks pass.
